title: Lipschitz Continuity, Nested 4-Rosetta Intervals, and the Archimedean Epsilon-Squeeze
description:
We prove that the Weierstrass-Euclid pinch gap Δ_N = t_N^2 / 2 is Lipschitz continuous with respect to the Dirichlet energy: |Δ_N - Δ_M| ≤ L |E_N - E_M| with Lipschitz constant L = 1/4. We prove that the two-sided pinch intervals I_N = [1/2, 1/2 + t_N^2 / 2] form a monotonic nested sequence I_{N+1} ⊆ I_N contracting toward the single point {1/2}. For every positive tolerance ε > 0, we provide an explicit Archimedean constructive threshold N^*(ε) = ⌈ exp(C_{BBLR} / ε) ⌉ + 2 such that for all N ≥ N^*, t_N^2 / 2 < ε. We formalize in Lean 4 the Lipschitz bound, interval nestedness, and Archimedean squeeze with zero custom axioms.

Formal Verification: Certified in Lean 4 with zero custom axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].
